hero.eyebrow: Clinic management in Arabic and English
hero.title: Bookings, visits and billing —
hero.title_accent: one calm workspace for your clinic.
hero.lead: DocBook gives your clinic an online booking page, a shared calendar built on each doctor's hours, a front desk that follows the waiting room, patient records with prescriptions, invoices, commissions and supplies — with a separate sign-in for every staff member.
hero.note: Setting up takes a few minutes: add your doctors, their hours and your services.

features.title: Everything the clinic day runs on
features.lead: From the first booking to the final invoice, every step lives in one place — and every person sees only what their role needs.

booking.title: Online booking
booking.text: Patients choose a doctor, a service and a free time from your clinic's page. New bookings arrive as pending for your team to confirm.

calendar.title: Smart calendar
calendar.text: Free times come from each doctor's shifts, breaks and days off, so the same time can never be booked twice.

frontdesk.title: Front desk & waiting room
frontdesk.text: Check patients in, see who is waiting and for how long, call them in and take payment at checkout.

records.title: Patient records & prescriptions
records.text: Vital signs, visit notes, diagnoses and printable prescriptions, kept in each patient's history.

billing.title: Invoices & insurance
billing.text: Numbered invoices with discounts, several payment methods and your insurance providers.

payroll.title: Doctor commissions & payroll
payroll.text: Commission rules per doctor with per-service exceptions, adjustments that need approval, and monthly payroll.

supplies.title: Supplies with low-stock alerts
supplies.text: Record stock in and out, and see at a glance which items reached their reorder level.

staff.title: Staff logins by role
staff.text: Doctors, nurses, reception and accountants each get their own sign-in and a view made for their work.

languages.title: Arabic & English
languages.text: The whole system works in Arabic (right to left) and English, in light or dark mode — printouts included.

booking.title: Your clinic's own booking page
booking.lead: Every clinic gets its own address with its doctors, services and working hours. Patients book in a minute from their phone, and your reception confirms.
booking.p1: Only real free times are offered — based on each doctor's schedule
booking.p2: Fees and prices appear only when you choose to show them
booking.p3: Your team is notified of every new online booking
booking.p4: Staff sign in from the same page, each to their own screen

frontdesk.title: A waiting room you can read at a glance
frontdesk.lead: Reception sees today's patients in order: who has arrived, who is waiting and for how long, who is with the doctor and who still needs to pay.
frontdesk.p2: Call the next patient in to the doctor
frontdesk.p3: Checkout creates the invoice with the payment method
frontdesk.p4: Each doctor sees only their own day

records.title: The patient's story in one file
records.lead: Nurses record vital signs, doctors write visit notes and prescriptions, and the whole history — visits, prescriptions and invoices — stays in the patient's file.
records.p1: Vital signs, SOAP visit notes and diagnosis
records.p2: Prescriptions from your medication list, ready to print
records.p3: Allergies and chronic conditions always in view
records.p4: Clinical notes stay hidden from roles that don't need them

steps.title: Up and running in four steps
steps.lead: No installation: DocBook runs in the browser on computers, tablets and phones.

s1.title: Create your clinic
s1.text: Sign up, name your clinic and choose its currency and time zone.

s2.title: Add doctors and services
s2.text: Set each doctor's working hours, appointment length and fee, then list your services.

s3.title: Give your team their sign-ins
s3.text: Add each staff member with a role: doctor, nurse, reception, accountant or clinic manager.

s4.title: Share your booking page
s4.text: Send patients your clinic's address — their bookings land straight in your calendar.

roles.title: The right screen for every role
roles.lead: Everyone signs in with their own account. Their role decides what they see and what they can change.

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.text: My day: their own appointments, visit notes, diagnoses and prescriptions.

nurse.title: Nurse
nurse.text: The waiting room, vital signs, patient records and supplies.

reception.title: Reception
reception.text: Bookings, check-in, patient files and payment at checkout.

accountant.title: Accountant
accountant.text: Invoices, payroll, commissions, expenses and reports — without clinical notes.

manager.title: Clinic manager
manager.text: The whole clinic: staff, doctors, services, settings and reports.

faq.title: Questions clinics ask us
faq.a1: Yes. Turn on online booking and share your clinic's page. Patients choose a doctor, a service and a free time; the booking arrives as pending until your team confirms it.
faq.q2: Does every staff member get their own sign-in?
faq.a2: Yes. Add staff with a role — doctor, nurse, reception, accountant or clinic manager. Each person sees only what their role allows, and a doctor sees only their own appointments.
faq.q3: Does it work fully in Arabic?
faq.a3: Yes. DocBook works in Arabic (right to left) and English, and each person can switch language at any time.
faq.q4: Can I run more than one clinic?
faq.a4: Yes. One account can belong to several clinics and switch between them, while each clinic's data stays separate.
faq.q5: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a5: No. DocBook runs in the browser on computers, tablets and phones.
faq.q6: Can I take my data out?
faq.a6: Yes. Lists and reports can be exported to Excel or CSV by the people whose role allows it.
faq.q7: Can I run more than one branch?
faq.a7: Yes. Depending on your plan, add your clinic's branches under Branches; each has its own doctors and appointments, and patients choose the branch when booking. The plan price follows the number of branches.
faq.q8: Can I change my plan later?
faq.a8: Yes. In subscription settings choose another plan or a monthly or yearly cycle; the new period starts when the paid one ends.

cta.title: Ready to open your clinic's DocBook?
cta.text: Create your clinic, add your doctors and share your booking page today.

stats.workspace: Workspace for every branch and the whole team

showcase.title: New features, built with clinics
showcase.lead: What clinics asked for over the last months: a complete clinic website, multiple branches, a smarter front desk, and clearer cash and invoices.

website.title: A clinic website with a visual editor
website.text: Pick a template and arrange sections: images, columns, reviews, FAQs and your doctors. Your logo in light and dark versions, your own domain, and booking built into the page.

branches.title: Multiple branches
branches.text: Add your branches, each with its doctors, appointments and address — patients choose the branch when they book.

booking.title: “Any available doctor” booking
booking.text: Patients book with the clinic without choosing a doctor; reception assigns the appointment later.

messages.title: Received and confirmed messages
messages.text: An automatic WhatsApp message when a request arrives and another when it is confirmed, with texts you edit.

intake.title: Vitals from the waiting room
intake.text: Reception or the nurse records blood pressure, temperature, weight and the reason for the visit before the patient goes in.

cash.title: Cash screen
cash.text: A fast checkout screen for reception, with a side column of who is waiting and who is with the doctor, and receipts printed straight away.

invoice.title: Invoice designer
invoice.text: Choose whether the logo and name show, where each one goes and how big the logo is, with a live preview.

telehealth.title: Video consultations
telehealth.text: Video calls with patients from inside the appointment — no extra apps.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.text: Summarises the visit, gives a second opinion and checks prescriptions; a finance assistant reviews the month — you always decide.

prices.title: Show or hide prices
prices.text: Decide whether doctors' and services' prices appear on the clinic website and on the booking page.

dark.title: Dark mode
dark.text: A calm night-time interface for the team, and a switch to turn it on or off on the clinic website.

orders.title: Lab & imaging orders
orders.text: An editable ready list of tests and imaging the doctor picks with a click; the request prints on the clinic letterhead with signature and stamp.

referrals.title: Referrals to specialists
referrals.text: A referral letter with the specialty, the reason and a case summary, printed on the clinic letterhead and kept in the patient file.

files.title: Scan papers into the patient file
files.text: Upload scanned paper forms, lab results and imaging reports (PDF or images) so they stay with the patient’s file.

pricing.title: A plan for every size of clinic
pricing.lead: Start small and move up whenever you need to. Paying yearly saves you more.
pricing.note: Prices in Jordanian dinars. Change your plan or number of branches at any time from subscription settings.

reps.title: A medical rep? Book your doctor visits in one place
reps.lead: Register for free as a rep, warehouse or company, see the clinics, their doctors and working hours, book or suggest a visit time, and get the clinic’s answer directly.
reps.p1: Every clinic open to reps and its doctors in one list
reps.p2: Free visit times, or the doctor’s working hours to suggest a time
reps.p3: The clinic’s answer by e-mail and in your account
reps.p4: Show your products and offers to clinics by specialty
